source.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
source.title: Circadian regulation of sunflower heliotropism, floral orientation, and pollinator visits

readScope: Publisher-deposited abstract supplied by Crossref; not the full research paper

claims.fact: 摘要描述未成熟向日葵植株的生长会追随太阳移动，不能忽略生长阶段。
claims.quote: The growth of immature sunflower plants tracks the Sun's movement.

claims.fact: 摘要明确花成熟开放后朝向稳定于东方，不支持所有成熟花盘一直随太阳转动。
claims.quote: As the flowers mature and open, they settle into a stable east-facing orientation.
